out_text: </think>The work above spans two linked efforts: the **hqmtp draft-head project** and the **bw24 research vault** it draws on. On the hqmtp side, the active thread is the novel il head distillation (task #9) — shrinking a co-trained MTP head and training it against quantized hiddens, a direction seeded by the owner's llama.cpp issue #25187 (FR-Spec trim-at-load gives −85% draft lm_head kernel but only +1–3% e2e, so the real target is the head itself).
